mapper.insert: INSERT INTO raffle_activity_account(user_id,activity_id) VALUES(#{userId},#{activityId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=user_id
mapper.select: SELECT user_id,activity_id,total_remaining,day_limit,month_limit,effective_draw_count,version FROM raffle_activity_account WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND activity_id=#{activityId} FOR UPDATE
